# Pull Request

GitHub offers no template chooser for pull requests. Pick the template of your change: append its parameter to this page's address and reload, for example `?quick_pull=1&template=server.md`.

| Parameter | Change |
|---|---|
| `template=server.md` | Server: `web-*` roles |
| `template=workstation.md` | Workstation: `dsk-*` roles |
| `template=system.md` | System: `sys-*`, `svc-*`, `dev-*`, `drv-*`, `pkgmgr`, `update-*`, or `user-*` |
| `template=pipeline.md` | Pipeline: CI/CD and workflows |
| `template=agents.md` | Agents: only `AGENTS.md` or `agents/*` |
| `template=documentation.md` | Documentation: only `.md` or `.rst` files outside `AGENTS.md` and `agents/*` |

Need help? [Support and Contact](../SUPPORT.md) · Matrix: `#public:infinito.nexus`
